audit.evidence: Real Docker build: Cacti git clone at release/1.2.26 (V0), release/1.2.27 (V1), release/1.2.29 (V2) on php:8.1-apache + real MariaDB 10.6. External HTTP trigger: GET /pcb_probe.php?action=run which includes REAL lib/api_automation.php in-place, calls real build_matching_objects_filter()+build_rule_item_filter()+api_automation_column_exists() against real MariaDB. 4-way differential observed: seed flag@V0 (source=PCBFLAG), seed blocked@V1 (source='SQL Injection'), residual flag@V1 (description=PCBFLAG via UNION), residual blocked@V2 (store_rejected=true, rows=[]).

v2.ref: git tag release/1.2.29 (CVE-2025-24368 fix, commit c7e4ee798d263a3209ae6e7ba182c7b65284d8f0)

sink.residual_param: automation match-rule-item `field` (WHERE-clause) — same tainted store, sibling sink

sink.reachability: Second-order: attacker (Automation admin) stores the field via automation_tree_rules.php, then triggers the tree preview / host.php automation which runs the matching query. Residual UNION surfaces pcb_secrets.secret into a reflected preview row (7-col query; flag lands in the `description` column). Verified genuinely exploitable on V1.
